name: Object Groups
description: A mod for grouping objects in the editor tabs

extra-tabs.name: Extra tabs
extra-tabs.description:
Which extra tabs should enabled

(extra tabs are the extra space for your <cg>objects</c> and <cg>groups</c>)

All tabs are equivalent, but you can use them for different purposes

show-names.name: Show group names
show-names.description:
Show the name of the group above objects when group is opened.

<cy>Note:</c> if the name is empty, it will not be shown

auto-close.name: Auto close groups
auto-close.description: Automatically close the group after selecting an object

append-deleted.name: Append deleted to the end
append-deleted.description:
Object Groups restricts the removal of objects from the tabs where they're located in vanilla GD. The rule is that: <cb>each object must appear in its original tab within the group or as an ungrouped object</c>. Otherwise this object will be automatically appended to the end of the tab (on the next editor reload). 

<cr>This is mainly made to prevent the permanent loss of the objects after deletion. That's why I recommend keeping this option enabled</c>

enable-pinning.name: Group pinning
enable-pinning.description:
<co>Allows you to pin groups so that they stay on the screen. This also allows you to DRAG groups across the screen</c>

- <cy>Button</c>: press the button to <cg>pin</c>/<cr>unpin</c> the group (then you'll be able to drag it across the screen)

- <cy>Gestures</c>: group is <cg>pinned</c> automatically when you start dragging it, drag it to the edge of the screen to <cr>unpin</c>

keep-pinned.name: Keep pinned groups
keep-pinned.description: Save the positions of pinned groups when re-entering the editor

hover-behavior.name: Group preview behavior
hover-behavior.description:
Group preview is designed to simplify interaction with groups by reducing the number of clicks you need to make to open the group and select the object.

 <cp>Click + Hover</c> - click on any group to open, then you can hover over other groups with your mouse to preview them

<cp>Hover</c> - hover over the groups with your mouse to preview them

<cp>Touch</c> - you can preview groups by holding the group button and dragging your touch across the menu (<co>note:</c> the only working option on mobile, will not work with tinker's scrollable menus)

ignore-hovered.name: Ignore previewed groups
ignore-hovered.description: Makes previewed groups uninteractable until you legitimately open them

shift-add.name: 'Shift' to add
shift-add.description:
Faster way to add objects to groups.

In <cg>group editing mode</c> press the 'shift' key and click on the object button you want to add. A new button will be added to the opened group

enable-search.name: Group search
enable-search.description:
Add a tab for searching groups by their names

<cy>Note:</c> it searches only for the groups, NOT for the individual objects

enable-goto-object.name: Object search
enable-goto-object.description:
Select an object and click <cy>'Find Object'</c> button (in the bottom left corner of build tabs menu) or press <cy>Ctrl + F</c>.

Object selected in editor will be highlighted in the build tab

group-button-color-v2.name: Button color
group-button-color-v2.description:
The color that all group buttons will have.

<cy>Note:</c> red, violet, blue, purple and pink buttons have the best contrast

(Option will have no effect if Creative mode by Alphalaneous is enabled)

bg-color-v2.name: Background color
bg-color-v2.description: Color and opacity of menu background

hover-color-v2.name: Background color (preview)
hover-color-v2.description: Color and opacity of menu background when you preview the group (see: 'group preview behavior' setting

used-font.name: Used font
used-font.description:
The font used to display the names of the groups

0: goldFont, 1-60: the same fonts as in editor font selection menu

goto-object.name: Go-to object
goto-object.description: Find and highlight selected object in the build tab

close-all.name: Close all groups
close-all.description: Close all opened and pinned groups
